basic_profile.bio: New to the Reddit scene, NeoDetective92 is a 30-year-old freelance graphic designer based in Manila, Philippines. With a penchant for all things cyberpunk, they spend their evenings delving into the neon-lit world of Night City. When not gaming, they enjoy binge-watching reality TV shows like 'Selling Sunset' and exploring local Filipino culture through subreddits like 'Bicol'. Typically online during late nights, they are single and enjoy the freedom of a flexible work schedule.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: NeoDetective92 has a self-taught background in graphic design, honed through years of freelancing. Their interest in cyberpunk themes stems from a long-standing fascination with dystopian narratives and futuristic technologies. They enjoy applying their design skills to create artwork inspired by their favorite games and movies.
